\section{The Spine: Summary of the War-Room Patterns}\label{sec:wr-catalog}

The patterns below are the stack's own rulings, promoted into the pattern
library and reproduced here from it. Almost all were forced by something
going wrong; \texttt{WR-0} is the exception, and was forced by the occasion
of writing this paper. They are implementation-non-specific on purpose:
they say what must hold, and give reasons for building one thing rather
than another. Each is stated here as its conclusion alone. The full
\textsc{if}/\textsc{however}/\textsc{then}/\textsc{because} entries, and the
case that forced each ruling, are in Appendix~\ref{app:wr-catalog}.

\paragraph{Organise As Effectively As War, Without Becoming A State Apparatus (\texttt{WR-0})}\label{pat:wr0}
\emph{An apparatus built to organise effectively must carry, from the outset, the three properties that stop it becoming an authority: an open model, an available exit, and a verdict it cannot issue to itself. Effective organisation and unaccountable apparatus are the same construction seen from two sides; only those properties separate them.}

\paragraph{Inhabit Before Building (\texttt{WR-4})}\label{pat:wr4}
\emph{Inhabit the surfaces that already exist before building new infrastructure; new infrastructure is justified only when it makes an existing surface more inhabitable.}

\paragraph{Typed Files Are Sources Of Truth, Prose Is Regenerated (\texttt{WR-8})}\label{pat:wr8}
\emph{Make the typed argument files the canonical self-model and generate prose from them, so drift becomes detectable instead of perennial.}

\paragraph{Bites Must Be Empirically Tested Or Marked Logical (\texttt{WR-9})}\label{pat:wr9}
\emph{Render self-model conflict claims as empirical only when session evidence supports them, and as logical otherwise, so the inhabitation gap stares back from the demo.}

\paragraph{Operationalised Exploit-Loops Are First-Class Observation Channels (\texttt{WR-16})}\label{pat:wr16}
\emph{Wire operationalised exploit-loops into the stack's status dashboard and the War Machine as direct typed evidence streams and first-class active-inference observation channels.}

\paragraph{Tension Must GENERATE, Not Only Rank (\texttt{WR-19})}\label{pat:wr19}
\emph{Wire structural tension as a candidate source that generates actions, not merely as a weight that ranks candidates generated elsewhere.}

\paragraph{A Removed Constraint Does Not Remove the Discipline It Supplied (\texttt{WR-24})}\label{pat:wr24}
\emph{When retiring a proxy constraint, install its replacement discipline in the same act and measure how much external verdict content changes subsequent work, not merely whether a verdict arrived.}

\paragraph{Good News Gets the Same Evidence Discipline as Bad (\texttt{WR-25})}\label{pat:wr25}
\emph{Let unanchored good news change ordering immediately but leave numerical posteriors unchanged until an artifact supports it.}

\paragraph{A Capability Switched Off Carries Its Re-Arm Condition, in Writing (\texttt{WR-26})}\label{pat:wr26}
\emph{Write a countable re-arm condition at the switch whenever an autonomous capability is turned off.}

\paragraph{A Loop Is Born Instrumented for Its Gain (\texttt{WR-27})}\label{pat:wr27}
\emph{Ship every new consumption-to-acquisition loop with an instrument that measures how much returned demand changes what the loop does next.}
